findings.namedBuyers: David Lugeon is the club’s published president/director of play and active-player correspondence contact; he authored the 2027 Marchissy announcement and is the strongest first route. Thierry Branca handled Signy 2026 registration confirmation and waiting-list requests; he is a relevant historical operational route, but his 2027 remit is unverified. Jean-Paul Palau is currently listed as secretary / adult activities and is an alternative internal introduction. None is evidenced as controlling accommodation contracts; no named housing buyer was found.
findings.futureEdition: The English directory advertises Nyon Chess Weekend on 29–30 January 2027, combining Friday blitz and Saturday standard play, but explicitly requires the official notice for the venue. Chessmates separately lists Tournoi Blitz Nyon on 29 January and Tournoi Nyon on 30 January, warning that the official announcement controls. No official combined-weekend announcement was verified. Crucially, the club officially announces Echecs et mets on Saturday 30 January 2027 in Marchissy: “date à la base prévue pour le tournoi annuel de Signy”. This is an identity/date conflict, not evidence that the two-day Nyon weekend is confirmed or canceled. No 2028 edition was located. Keep verified dates for the target umbrella event null; the separately confirmed Marchissy activity falls within the requested horizon.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment using the supplied hotel specification: YOTEL Founex is potentially relevant to Nyon/La Côte activity, but is not the announced Marchissy playing/dining site. A day tournament does not establish overnight demand. Consider only evidenced visiting players/officials needing lodging or a separately scoped future workshop; do not underwrite a 20–120-room block, whole-house demand, transport service or restaurant/banquet capacity. Six supplied meeting rooms could support a future chess workshop, subject to layout, budget and catering checks; theatre capacity is not chess-table capacity. This is neither a verified destination-resort event nor downtown-Geneva overflow. No event-specific airport-arrival, hotel-transfer or overnight itinerary evidence was found; generic directory airport advice is not attendee travel evidence.
findings.venueCommitments: Target Nyon Chess Weekend: exact venue null; Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland is secondary-reported only. Do not substitute the club’s regular premises or the historical Signy shopping centre. Separate Echecs et mets: Marchissy is official; Chessmates specifies “Marchissy - auberge LaMarmite, Place Du Tilleul 6, 1261 Marchissy”. Switzerland Tourism corroborates that restaurant identity/address, not the event booking. Thus the precise establishment has secondary event-specific support, not an inspected contract or official hall confirmation. Marchissy is in the district of Nyon, Vaud, in the La Côte/Jura Vaudois catchment, not Geneva city, Lausanne or France. No guestroom commitment is evidenced.
findings.historicalRotation: Related Signy series, not a verified history of the English umbrella brand: official 2017 report records 131 Saturday participants at Signy; official 2025 results identify Friday 31 January and Saturday 1 February, although one cadet paragraph inconsistently says 3 February; official 2026 announcement specifies 30–31 January at centre commercial de Signy. The 2027 club notice allocates the date originally intended for annual Signy to Echecs et mets at Marchissy. This supports recurring club tournaments and a changed programme, not a proven rotating hotel congress or confirmed successor identity.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No organizer-issued housing bureau, host hotel, room block, room rate, accommodation RFP or independently bookable event allocation was found. The directory’s “Accommodation Near the Venue” section names EVERY listed option: Base Nyon; Hotel Real Nyon; B&B Hotel Nyon. These are third-party proximity suggestions, not organizer-designated partners or booking commitments. The official Marchissy notice instead states “Il n’est pas possible de jouer sans manger, c’est le concept convivial qui prime.” This establishes compulsory dining, not compulsory lodging or a hotel package. Independent self-booking remains an unverified possibility, not a verified sourcing mechanism.
findings.organizationStructure: Cercle d’échecs de Nyon is a member chess club with president, treasurer, secretary, adult/junior activities and a committee; the club says it organizes the Marchissy tournament. Classification: sports club / association-style organizer, not a hotel, corporate end-client, PCO or DMC. Formal legal registration was not verified. No separate agency or housing intermediary was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No incumbent accommodation hotel or committed housing bureau was verified. Base Nyon, Hotel Real Nyon and B&B Hotel Nyon are directory suggestions only. LaMarmite is the separately reported playing/dining establishment; its own site calls it a restaurant, so do not classify it as a competing accommodation hotel without room evidence. The Signy 2026 notice says Saturday entries were nearing their limit and describes a waiting list; this is playing-capacity evidence, NOT lodging sell-out or overflow. No sourced overflow, room-night figure or 2027 attendance count was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact David Lugeon at the club-published davidlugeon@hotmail.com, copying Thierry Branca at thierry.branca@gmail.com only as the documented Signy 2026 registration contact. First reconcile whether the 29 January blitz / 30 January Nyon listings remain valid and how they relate to Echecs et mets at Marchissy. Request the official 2027 flyer/registration terms, exact hall, nonlocal participant/official count, overnight dates, existing accommodation arrangements and permission for an optional YOTEL booking link. Do not quote a block before demand is established. If no overnight visitors exist, retain a low-priority club relationship rather than a room-revenue opportunity.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Unqualified for a hotel-block sales approach. The target two-day identity/venue remains unverified; the official 30 January Marchissy programme already links play with compulsory dining. Accommodation access is unknown, not closed and not open. Only after confirming nonlocal overnight visitors and freedom to choose lodging should YOTEL offer a participant booking route; do not attempt to displace the announced meal programme.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional relationship-development hypothesis: ask the club about future organizer/official lodging and small off-site training events in the Nyon/La Côte catchment. Historical tournament recurrence supports a conversation, not a confirmed 2028 tender or annual room demand. A hotel-hosted play-and-meal format would require club interest, chess-table layout and verified catering economics; no open venue competition or relocation intention was found.
